passives: Agon of the Sky Court: Helior Bronze Summit gains Laurel Favor when its artillery choices express Celestial Heights of Olympus source-culture law through trial-marked arena ground; Earth myth is only the later echo.
lore: Helior Bronze Summit is a colossal Olympian artillery from The Celestial Heights of Olympus. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Deity is the older source: Olympian artillery office: far-sight strike, horizon pressure, prophetic range; Hermes: crossings, heralds, speed, trick boundaries.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source deity, not a costume: Helior Bronze Summit shows living marble-light bodies, bronze cuirasses, laurel circuits, aegis scales, thunder tribunal auras, oracle smoke, amphitheater armor curves, hoplite shield geometry, winged victory accents, gold-blue skyfire, carved but non-readable relief bands.. Role silhouette must read as Artillery. Materials include living white marble, warm bronze, laurel green, aegis scale gold, storm blue, oracle violet smoke, ambrosial ivory. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid generic toga costume, Roman gladiator confusion, marble statue stiffness, robot bronze automaton, sci-fi aura, neon arena grid.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Helior Bronze Summit — Aegis Spear Thrust Longshot
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Olympian source-culture damage at range 5; generate Momentum and a small Laurel Favor gain when used from trial-marked arena ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as living marble-light, bronze cuirass, laurel circuits, aegis scales, oracle smoke, thunder tribunal auras, hoplite shield geometry.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Laurel Trial Technique — Horizon Lock
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to marks distant lanes, punishes exposed routes, and demands line-of-sight counterplay. Builds Laurel Favor only when the player uses trial-marked arena ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Helior Bronze Summit: Olympian Verdict Contest Cataclysm Line
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Laurel Favor to impose a two-round rule from Celestial Heights of Olympus: marks distant lanes, punishes exposed routes, and demands line-of-sight counterplay. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Nike Crowned Ascension
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Laurel Favor, transform nearby terrain into trial-marked arena ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Helior Bronze Summit Far-Sight Aegis Laurel Spear
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through trial-marked arena ground. Visual: living marble-light, bronze cuirass, laurel circuits, aegis scales, oracle smoke, thunder tribunal auras, hoplite shield geometry.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Helior Bronze Summit Living Marble Bronze Cuirass
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Celestial Heights of Olympus source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Helior Bronze Summit Oracle Ambrosia Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Laurel Favor and unlocks a mastery branch for Hermes Crossing Step, Athena Countermeasure, and Claim the Laurel. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: project damage into crowds and objective zones
